pools.four_rep_one_each: candidate 1 from raw, naive summary, event abstraction, temporal abstraction

policies.first: pool slot 1 when any hard-pass candidate exists; otherwise explicit abstain
policies.random: deterministic SHA-256 random choice when any hard-pass exists; otherwise explicit abstain
policies.hard_filter: first hard-pass candidate; otherwise explicit abstain
policies.score_ranking: highest visible-only score when any hard-pass exists; otherwise explicit abstain
policies.abstain: highest-scoring hard-pass candidate; otherwise explicit abstain
policies.fallback: highest-scoring hard-pass candidate; otherwise explicit fallback to slot 1
policies.oracle_upper_bound: first held-out strict-success candidate; evaluation ceiling only

visible_score: unweighted sum of the nine allow-listed binary features
heldout_strict_success: heldout correct pass AND buggy fail AND antecedent hit AND non-vacuous
